answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a physical unclonable function embedded in its trusted kernel, so a sybil must replicate hardware entropy rather than merely copy keys. Like suppressing TLS loss by annealing an umber oxide layer until only a stable ember of dielectric response remains, the protocol weights each identity by sustained coherence time, making. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
